description.zh: 预热计划ID，由 CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions 返回的 SuccessExecutions[].Id 字段获取。调用本接口前需先通过 CreateScheduledPreloadJob 创建预热任务，再通过 CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions 创建执行计划。
description.en: The preload plan ID, obtained from the SuccessExecutions[].Id field returned by CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions. Before calling this API, you must first create a preload task by calling CreateScheduledPreloadJob, and then create an execution plan by calling CreateScheduledPreloadExecutions.

title.zh: 停止单个定时预热计划
title.en: Stop a Single Scheduled Preload Execution Plan
